exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 How Do You Make Friends?
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Tom: Hi Sophie, how do you usually make new friends?
Sophie: I like joining clubs where people share my interests. Last term I joined the drama club.
Tom: That sounds fun. I usually make friends online first, and then meet them later.
Sophie: Really? Isn't that a little risky?
Tom: It can be, so I am always careful and never share private information at first.
Sophie: That's wise. For me, talking face to face feels more real.
Tom: I understand. Maybe the best way is to use both.
Sophie: I agree. What matters most is being honest and kind.
exercises.translation_cn: Tom 问 Sophie 怎样交新朋友;Sophie 喜欢参加兴趣相投的社团,上学期加入了戏剧社;Tom 则常先在网上交友再见面;Sophie 觉得有点冒险;Tom 说会小心、起初不透露私人信息;Sophie 更喜欢面对面;两人都认为最重要的是真诚和善良。

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 How Friends Once Kept in Touch
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Long ago, friends who lived far apart had very few ways to keep in touch.
The most common way was to write letters, which could take weeks to arrive.
Later, the telephone made it faster to hear a friend's voice.
Today, social media and video calls let us talk to faraway friends in seconds.
Yet no matter how the tools change, the wish to stay close to our friends stays the same.
exercises.translation_cn: 很久以前,异地的朋友几乎没有保持联系的办法;最常见的是写信,要好几周才到;后来电话让人能更快听到朋友的声音;如今社交媒体和视频通话让我们几秒就能和远方朋友交谈;但无论工具怎么变,想与朋友亲近的愿望始终不变。

options: Hearing a friend's voice more quickly.

options: The wish to stay close to our friends.

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 Planning a Surprise Party
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Ben: Emma's birthday is next Friday. Shall we plan a surprise for her?
Mia: Great idea! She loves music, so how about a small party with her favourite songs?
Ben: Perfect. I can bring a cake. Could you invite her close friends?
Mia: Sure. Let's keep it a secret so she is really surprised.
Ben: Good thinking. Where should we have it?
Mia: How about the school garden after class? It's quiet there.
Ben: That works. Let's tell everyone to arrive before she does.
Mia: Agreed. This is going to be the best birthday surprise ever!
exercises.translation_cn: Ben 提议为下周五过生日的 Emma 准备惊喜;Mia 赞成,提议办个放她喜欢歌曲的小派对;Ben 负责带蛋糕,请 Mia 邀请她的好友;两人决定保密好让她惊喜;地点定在放学后安静的学校花园;让大家在她到之前先到;期待这是最棒的生日惊喜。

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 How to Keep a Friendship Alive
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Making a friend is easy, but keeping a friendship alive takes effort from both sides.
First, stay in touch often, even with just a short message.
Second, listen carefully when your friend has a problem, instead of only talking about yourself.
Third, be honest, but always be kind.
And when you make a mistake, say sorry quickly, because a friendship that is cared for can last a lifetime.
exercises.translation_cn: 交朋友容易,但维系友谊需要双方努力;第一,常联系,哪怕只是一条短消息;第二,朋友有烦恼时认真倾听,而不是只谈自己;第三,要诚实,但永远要善良;犯错时尽快道歉,因为用心呵护的友谊能维持一生。

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 Helping a Worried Friend
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Lucy: You look worried, Jack. What's wrong?
Jack: My best friend is moving to another city next month. I'm afraid we'll lose touch.
Lucy: I understand. But these days it's easy to stay in touch online.
Jack: That's true. We could video-call every weekend.
Lucy: Exactly. And you can still share photos and messages every day.
Jack: You're right. Maybe distance doesn't have to end a friendship.
Lucy: It doesn't. Real friends stay close, however far apart they live.
Jack: Thanks, Lucy. I feel much better now.
exercises.translation_cn: Lucy 见 Jack 发愁;Jack 说最好的朋友下个月要搬到别的城市,担心会失去联系;Lucy 说如今上网很容易保持联系;Jack 想到可以每周末视频通话;Lucy 说还能每天分享照片和消息;Jack 明白距离不必终结友谊;Lucy 说真朋友无论隔多远都会亲密如初;Jack 道谢,心情好多了。

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 A Friend in Need
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: There is an old saying: a friend in need is a friend indeed.
It means that a true friend is the one who helps you when you are in trouble, not only when life is easy.
Anyone can be there for the good times.
But the friends who stay by your side during hard days are the ones worth keeping.
So when a friend needs you, do not turn away; be the friend you would want to have.
exercises.translation_cn: 有句老话:患难见真情;意思是真正的朋友是在你有难时帮你的人,而不只是顺境时;顺境时谁都能陪你;但在艰难日子里仍守在你身边的朋友才值得珍惜;所以当朋友需要你时,别转身离开,要做你自己也希望拥有的那种朋友。
